meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 为项目添加 Discord 机器人频道支持，让机器人能通过 Discord 私信或服务器频道与你对话。过程包括复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、运行测试，以及配置凭据和邀请机器人。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Discord 机器人或频道集成时触发。

say.text: 请为这个项目添加 Discord 机器人集成。
say.note: 会开始复制适配器、注册依赖并引导你配置凭据。

say.text: 帮我接入 Discord，让机器人能发私信给我。
现在把 Discord 频道加到我的聊天里。
say.note: 会执行安装步骤并让你邀请机器人到共享服务器。

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot support over Chat SDK: the bot can talk in server channels or DMs. Steps include copying the adapter, registering it, installing a pinned dependency, building, testing, setting credentials, and inviting the bot.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Discord bot or channel integration.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot integration to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and guides through credentials.

say_en.text: Set up Discord so the bot can DM me.
say_en.note: Requires a Discord app and Bot Token.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to my chat now.
say_en.note: Runs install steps and invites the bot to a shared server.
